messages:
henry-partnerops: Small heads-up: BrightHub (hardware partner) wants marketplace onboarding. They emit 30s-level heartbeat counts; seller portal needs hourly entitlements. Need ingest strategy and reconciliation plan. cc @mira-eng @ada-billing
mira-eng: Quick question — do they include device_id and batch_id in payloads?
henry-partnerops: yes, sample: `{
  "device_id": "bh-12",
  "sku": "bright-mini",
  "ts": "2026-04-01T14:00:30Z",
  "pulses": 1,
  "batch_id": "b-20260401-1400"
}` They push every minute and sign with HMAC.
ada-billing: Billing requirement: aggregate to total minutes per UTC hour, round up partial minutes only after summing seconds. Need idempotency on batch_id.
mira-eng: Plan: ingest adapter will normalize to seconds, dedupe on (device_id, second, sku), store raw events for 90 days, then roll up to hour_start. Late arrivals: marketplace policy 48h. Should we allow 72h as manual review?
henry-partnerops: Partner requests 72h max, but ok with 48h automated. We'll flag >48h for ops review.
sylvia-ps: Product wants seller-portal to show an "adjusted" badge for hours changed post-cut and an optional debug view listing per-minute pulses.
ingest-bot: ingest: batch b-20260401-1400 accepted, signature verified, written to s3://partners/brighthub/b-20260401-1400 (2026-04-01T14:05:12Z)
mira-eng: QA tests: duplicate batch replay, out-of-order seconds, and >48h backfill handling. I'll own spike and unit tests.
ada-billing: Reconciliation: nightly job outputs diff CSV with fields run_id,hour_start,sku,partner_minutes,our_minutes,delta. Tolerance: <=1 minute or <=0.5%. Above that auto-open a ticket.
henry-partnerops: Action items: @mira-eng build adapter spike, @ada-billing draft reconciliation email/webhook, I'll coordinate partner sandbox. Thanks all :thumbsup:
